document.title: Form PF.23/A — Payment Instructions for the Commencement of a Deferred Retirement Benefit

chunks.part: Form PF.23/A — Payment Instructions for the Commencement of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: What is Form PF.23/A used for?
chunks.text: Form PF.23/A is used to request the commencement of a deferred retirement benefit under Article 30 of the UNJSPF Regulations.

chunks.part: Form PF.23/A — Payment Instructions for the Commencement of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: What information is required in Sections 1 and 2?
chunks.text: Section 1 (Participant information) requires UID, pension number, date of birth, full name, mailing address, phone, and personal email. Section 2 (Date of commencement of deferred retirement benefit) requires the desired date on which the benefit is to become payable.

chunks.part: Form PF.23/A — Payment Instructions for the Commencement of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: What is required in Sections 3 and 4?
chunks.text: Section 3 requires standard bank account information (payee name, bank details, currency, account type, intermediary bank, and additional bank account information for institutions such as brokerage firms). Section 4 requires confirming the form's instructions have been read, and enclosing a government photo ID and a recent bank statement or voided cheque plus all other required documents.

chunks.part: Form PF.23/A — Payment Instructions for the Commencement of a Deferred Retirement Benefit
chunks.heading: When is Section 5 (Signature Authentication) required?
chunks.text: Section 5 requires a UN official, government official, or notary public to certify that the person identified in Section 1 signed the form in their presence, providing their printed name, title/licence/index number, email, signature, date, and official stamp/seal of office.
